# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `myanimetracker` MCP server pointing at MyAnimeTracker's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://myanimetracker.com/api/mcp/account`).
- Read-only tools work without an account; list tools use OAuth sign-in with a free myanimetracker.com account.
- Logo: references `https://myanimetracker.com/logo-light-plate.png` by URL; the image could not be downloaded when this plugin was added.
